title: dcp config set reply (schema MAJOR 1)
description: What Aurora expects from `dcp config set --json [--dry-run] --dir <root> --revision <revision> --value <key>=<JSON value> [--value ...]`, offered with the capability `config` schema_major 1. Each --value names one key of `dcp config get` and its new value as JSON ("trunk", false, 400, ["a","b"], null). The values are checked with the same validation as the engine, all or nothing: when any check fails nothing is written. With --dry-run nothing is ever written. Exit code 0 with this reply whenever the request was understood, including refused values (errors not empty, applied false); any other exit code is a failure and standard error explains it. The engine never commits.

root.description: The repository root the reply is about (absolute path)

applied.description: true only when the file was written (never with --dry-run, never with errors)

revision.description: The file's revision after the command: the new one when applied, else the current one

changes.description: One entry per key whose value differs from the file, in the order given; keys whose new value equals the current one are left out

diff.description: Unified diff of the configuration file, empty when nothing changes or with errors

code.description: stale_revision: the file changed since --revision was read; invalid_file: the current file cannot be parsed

key.description: The key the error is about, or null for the whole request

accepted.description: The accepted values, when the error is about a value outside them

value.description: A setting value, as in dcp.config: boolean, integer, text, list of text, or null when not set
